scope: Real Stripe sandbox signed forwarding -> application route/inbox/handlers -> isolated Supabase Auth/PostgREST/RLS
checks: Unpaid student denied by RPC and real RLS
Real initial payment grants paid interval and lesson access
Failed renewal preserves only already-paid interval
Cancellation preserves already-paid interval without extension
After paid interval expires, RPC and RLS deny lesson access
limits: Stripe SDK network calls use a CLI OAuth adapter; production SDK credential transport not exercised
HTTP harness invokes the real route, not a deployed Next server
Expiry boundary simulated by changing only the synthetic local subscription access_until; Stripe test clocks do not move PostgreSQL time
No production writes, charges, or sales activation
